name: The Long Winter
about: The snow comes early and stays. The north is starving while the south's granaries are full, and beyond the wall the dead are stirring. You can't feed everyone, and the north will remember who left it to starve.
title: The Long Winter

beats.speaker: north
beats.text: Snow falls on {northseat} before the harvest is in, and it doesn't melt. {north} counts the stores and doesn't like the number.

court.text: {north} of {north.house}: "Winter's come early to {northseat}, Your Grace, and it's staying. My people will starve by spring without grain from the south."

options.label: Send grain north from the royal stores (200 gold)
options.result: Wagons of the King's grain roll north through the snow. {north} meets them at the gate in person.

options.label: Order {south.house} to send its spare grain north
options.result: On the King's order, {south.house} sends its grain north, and counts every sack.

options.label: Tell the north to fend for itself
options.hint: {north.houseName} −15 · the north starts to resent you
options.result: The crown sends the north its sympathy and nothing else. {north} reads the letter out to {north.his} hungry hall.

beats.speaker: north
text: The second winter is worse than the first. In {northseat} they're eating the seed corn, and in {granary} the granaries are full.
Wolves come down to the villages around {northseat}, and so do the starving. {south.house}'s barns at {granary} are under armed guard.

court.text: {north}: "{south} is sitting on full granaries while my people boil leather to eat, Your Grace. If you won't open them, the north will."

options.label: Seize {south.house}'s granaries for the north
options.result: The King's men break the seals on the barns at {granary}. {south} watches from the walls.

options.label: Buy grain from across the sea (400 gold)
options.hint: everyone eats · your treasury is emptied
options.result: Ships from across the sea unload grain at the river mouth. The crown's coffers are close to empty.

options.label: Ask for prayers and patience
options.hint: costs nothing now · the north starves
options.result: Every sept in the realm prays for the north. The north buries its children.

beats.speaker: north
beats.text: Beyond the old wall, in the long dark, the dead are walking. Riders reach {northseat} with frost in their beards and fear in their eyes.

court.text: {north}: "The dead are at the wall, Your Grace. The north will hold if you stand with us. Send the royal army, or tell me straight that we're on our own."

options.label: Send the royal army north (300 gold)
options.hint: {north.houseName} +25 · Kingsmere is left with fewer men
options.result: The royal army marches north under the King's banner, and the north sings in the snow.

options.label: Refuse to send a single man
options.result: The King's answer reaches {northseat}. {north} burns it unread in front of the hall.

beats.speaker: north
beats.text: "A King who won't feed us and won't fight for us is no King of ours." {north} takes the old crown of the north out of its chest and marches south.

beats.speaker: north
beats.text: The snow finally goes. The north buries its dead, mends its wall, and remembers that the crown came when it was called.

beats.speaker: south
beats.text: The northern army breaks at Kingsmere. When the thaw comes the realm still has one crown, but the north holds a grudge that will outlive everyone in it.
{north} dies in the snow, and the new lord of {north.house} has no stomach for a winter war. {thread} passes with the season.
